## SearchTickets

```go
func (s *SmartTransferService) SearchTickets(ctx context.Context, params *SearchTicketsParams, opts ...RequestOption) (*SmartTransferTicketFilteredResponse, error)
```

`GET /smart-transfers` · rate-limit category: `query`

**Find Ticket**

Find tickets by their title or ticker. You can also query all tickets without filters by not providing any input parameters.
**Endpoint Permissions:** Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `params.Q` | query | `string` |  | Search string - counterparty name or asset or ticketId. Optional |
| `params.Statuses` | query | [`[]SearchTicketsStatusesItem`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#SearchTicketsStatusesItem) |  | Ticket statuses for Smart Transfer tickets. Optional |
| `params.NetworkID` | query | `string` |  | NetworkId that is used in the ticket	. Optional |
| `params.CreatedByMe` | query | `bool` |  | Filter created tickets by created by self or by others. Optional |
| `params.ExpiresAfter` | query | `string` |  | Lower bound of search range. Optional |
| `params.ExpiresBefore` | query | `string` |  | Upper bound of search range. Optional |
| `params.Type` | query | [`SearchTicketsType`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#SearchTicketsType) |  | Type of transfer. ASYNC executes transfers as they are funded, DVP executes all terms (legs) as one dvp transfer |
| `params.ExternalRefID` | query | `string` |  | External ref. ID that workspace can use to identify ticket outside of Fireblocks system. |
| `params.After` | query | `string` |  | ID of the record after which to fetch $limit records |
| `params.Limit` | query | `float64` |  | Number of records to fetch. By default, it is 100 |
| `params.SortBy` | query | [`SearchTicketsSortBy`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#SearchTicketsSortBy) |  | Sort by field |
| `params.Order` | query | [`SearchTicketsOrder`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#SearchTicketsOrder) |  | ASC / DESC ordering (default DESC) |

**Returns:** [`*SmartTransferTicketFilteredResponse`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otyang/fireblocks-go#SmartTransferTicketFilteredResponse)
